AreaSurvival

A fan-run Minecraft server where Java and Bedrock players play together.

Server address
areasurvival.cedlabs.net
  • Java 1.8+

View server status Discord

How to join

Java Edition

  1. Open Minecraft and click Multiplayer.
  2. Click Add Server and paste the address.
  3. Click Done, then join the server.

Versions 1.8+. No port needed.

Bedrock Edition

  1. Tap Play, then open the Servers tab.
  2. Scroll down and tap Add Server.
  3. Enter the address and port 19132, then save.

Works on Android, iOS and Windows.

Good to know

Crossplay

Java Edition 1.8+ and Bedrock Edition players share the same server.

Live status

The status page checks the server every 30 seconds and shows uptime and player activity.

Community

Join the AreaSurvival Discord for announcements and help.

A fan-run Minecraft server. Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
